'''Ding''' was a tame [[kusak]] that lived on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the beast was part of a pack of ten kusaks, including [[Bedhead]], [[Blinky]], [[Scarecrow (kusak)|Scarecrow]], [[Slobbers]], [[Troubles]], [[Wart Face]], [[Gargle]], [[Runt (kusak)|Runt]] and [[Speedbump]], trained by the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] to guard [[Nym's Stronghold]].<ref name="SWG:CftK" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an adventurer fed the creature with [[Lokkian weed]]. Ding only liked a special kind of weed, so the adventurer had to collect and try different plants to find the one Ding preferred.<ref name="SWG:CftK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ding appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CftK" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ding was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:CftK" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>

The kusak was part of the "[[:w:c:swg:Caring for the Kusaks|Caring for the Kusaks]]" [[:w:c:swg:Collection|collection]]. Each time a player finished the "[[:w:c:swg:Ran Machado|Weed Whacker Foliage Requisition]]" quest, the player was rewarded with one of ten different kinds of Lokian weed. These could be used to feed the kusaks, but each of the ten different kusaks in or near the stronghold only accepted one randomly determined kind of weed.<ref name="SWG:CftK" />
